title: AI Change Provenance: separation of duties for software written with coding agents
description: AI Change Provenance (ACP) is a specification for one question about a software change: did a human who is independent of the change's effective author approve it? The effective author may be a coding agent and the human who directed it. This archive holds the specification, its JSON Schemas, the evaluator conformance corpus (conformance/), and acc, the reference implementation: a deterministic, offline evaluator that emits a re-evaluable manifest and an in-toto attestation.
